content: HTTP semantics (MDN + RFC 7231 + AEP-211): 401 = unauthenticated (missing/invalid credentials, WWW-Authenticate); 403 = authenticated but insufficient permissions; RFC 7231 permits 404 instead of 403 to hide resource existence; AEP-211 argues for 403 with 'permission denied on resource (or it might not exist)' wording to avoid existence leak while staying debuggable. Next.js mode: middleware returns 401 JSON for API, redirect to /login for pages; role failure in route handler = 403.
